groups.name: HYFLOCK

groups.name: Inc Ransom
groups.profile: INC Ransom, active since mid-2023; spear-phishing and exploitation of Citrix/FortiGate edge devices. All three are RansomLook-only and have no country tag.

groups.name: MedusaLocker
groups.profile: Long-running RaaS (since 2019) relying on exposed RDP and phishing.

groups.name: PixelLeaks
groups.profile: Posts descriptive, unnamed targets with publication deadlines and itemised record lists, rather than naming companies.

groups.name: Qilin
groups.profile: Prolific RaaS (aka Agenda) since 2022; Rust/Go lockers, VMware ESXi targeting, double extortion; among 2025–26's most active groups.

groups.name: Dire Wolf
groups.profile: Double-extortion group that surfaced in 2025, leaning on manufacturing and technology firms; Ransomware.live tags it “direwolf”.

groups.name: EndZone
groups.profile: Little-documented leak site. Today's listing claims both encryption and 250 GB+ of exfiltration, and quotes revenue metadata.

groups.name: N0n
groups.profile: Two of those today (Company #242, #243, tagged “healthcare · United States, pending exposure”) were excluded as masked.

groups.name: Panzer
groups.profile: Small leak site with sparse history and no published TTP profile.

groups.name: Rhysida
groups.profile: RaaS since May 2023 (subject of a 2023 CISA advisory); hits healthcare, education, government and legal; publishes large file inventories.

groups.name: Scarlettgroup
groups.profile: Small, newer leak site focused on hospitals.

groups.name: The Gentlemen
groups.profile: Group that emerged in 2025, known for deploying its locker across domains via Group Policy; mid-size, multi-sector targeting.
